A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same VLOD-TTA research work and complete 32-page documents, including supplementary Sections 6.1–6.5 and references. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp and its link differ.

before.justification: v2 reports original detection experiments, ablations and efficiency measurements in Section 4, with further empirical analyses and benchmark results in Section 6.

after.justification: v3 retains the original detection experiments, ablations, efficiency measurements and supplementary empirical results reported in v2.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical IoU-weighted entropy minimization, image-conditioned prompt selection, adapters, text residuals and single-step adaptation with per-image parameter resets.

E1.justification: Coverage is identical: Watercolor, ClipArt, Comic, Cityscapes, BDD100K, ExDark, PASCAL-C and COCO-C, plus the supplementary Aquarium evaluation and VOC/COCO fine-tuning experiments.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including ZS, TPT, VPT, DPE and Adapter in the main benchmarks, TTAOD-F in Tables 5 and 16, and the supplementary controls.

E3.justification: Both versions report identical metrics, detector configurations, batch-size-one single-step adaptation settings and supplementary protocols, including resolution, augmentation and fine-tuning experiments.

E4.justification: The component, prompt and adapter ablations, hyperparameter sensitivity studies, batch-size and augmentation analyses, Cityscapes failure analysis and qualitative examples are identical in the main text and supplement.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged throughout the tables, plots and accompanying text. No repeated-run, seed, uncertainty-estimation or significance-reporting information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples are identical. For example, Table 5 retains average COCO-C mAP of 26.0 for TTAOD-F, 26.2 for VLOD-TTA and 27.3 for its warm-start variant.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives in Section 3 and the cosine–Euclidean equivalence proposition and proof in Section 6.1 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical contributions and claims concerning IWE, IPS, robustness under distribution shifts and efficient adaptation of CNN- and transformer-based detectors.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same mechanism interpretations and limitations, including weak proposal overlap for small objects, rider/person ambiguity in Cityscapes and adaptation latency relative to zero-shot inference.

D1.justification: Implementation and adapter details, hyperparameters, hardware reporting and the code-access link are unchanged. The updated arXiv self-link only identifies the later document version.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 44 references are identical, including the positioning against TTAOD-F. No cited works or substantive novelty comparisons are added or removed.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 17 Mar 2026 to v3 dated 27 Jun 2026, with its version link updated accordingly. Body language, headings and document structure are identical.

P2.justification: All 11 figures and 21 tables retain identical content, captions and placement. Pages 2–32 render identically; the first-page body is also identical, with only the marginal version/date text changing.

improvement.justification: v3 only updates the arXiv version/date stamp and its self-link. The scientific content, empirical evidence, supplementary material, reproducibility information and substantive presentation are identical, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
